column1: Method: Identify features that are EITHER (a) referenced/expected by the product surface (frontend nav, Phase 73/75 scope docs, role definitions, or standard expectations for a school SMS) but NOT implemented anywhere, OR (b) implemented in frontend but with no backend backing, OR (c) present in phase scope but missing from code.
IMPORTANT: A feature is only "MISSING" if there is positive evidence of expected-but-absent behavior. Absence of a feature never seen in any artifact is NOT logged.
